# The app bar, where a person goes back and picks from a menu: android's
# TopAppBar and DropdownMenu, and html's header. A test opens a submenu by
# picking its top-level entry, which on android clicks the action and opens its
# DropdownMenu, and then picks a checked entry inside it. The system back is
# sngl:test/mobile's `back`: android's back key, which the window's BackHandler
# answers with `@back` while `canGoBack` holds, ahead of a NavHost's own pop,
# and the browser's back on html, which pops the entry the window's
# `sngl-back` keeps. testdata/window_menu.txtar and nav_can_go_back.txtar are
# the code.

sngl test --platform=html back.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin back.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

# Over a NavHost, the system back is the window's `@back`, which pops the page.
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin navback.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- back.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"
import mobile "sngl:test/mobile"

const sizes = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

component app root {
    var size = "Medium"
    var depth = 0
    var backs = 0

    ui.window #main(title="Depth {depth}", canGoBack=depth > 0, @back {
        backs += 1
        depth -= 1
    }) {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                for var s = sizes {
                    ui.menuItem(label=s, checked=s == size, @select { size = s })
                }
            }
        }
        ui.text #shown(value=size)
        ui.button #deeper(text="Deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
    }
}

app()

func testAPickedEntryIsChecked(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.menu[0].children[1].checked)
    c.main.menu[0].select()
    c.main.menu[0].children[2].select()
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "Large")
    t.assert(c.main.menu[0].children[2].checked && !c.main.menu[0].children[1].checked)
}

func testTheSystemBackGoesBack(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.deeper.click()
    t.assert(c.main.canGoBack)
    mobile.back()
    t.assert(c.depth == 0 && c.backs == 1)
    t.assert(!c.main.canGoBack)
}

func testTheUpArrowGoesBack(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.deeper.click()
    c.deeper.click()
    c.main.back()
    t.assert(c.depth == 1 && c.backs == 1)
}
-- navback.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import "sngl:test"
import mobile "sngl:test/mobile"

component app root {
    ui.window #main(title=pages.current.title, canGoBack=pages.canGoBack(), @back { pages.back() }) {
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                ui.text(value="home")
            }
            nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
                ui.text(value="about")
            }
        }
        ui.button #toAbout(text="About", @click { pages.go(about) })
    }
}

app()

func testTheSystemBackPopsThePage(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.toAbout.click()
    t.assert(c.main.title == "About")
    mobile.back()
    t.assert(c.main.title == "Home")
    t.assert(!c.pages.canGoBack())
}
